newsitem.title: USA: Mafco gets $38.50/shr buyout from parent.
newsitem.headline: Mafco gets $38.50/shr buyout from parent.

text.p: Mafco Consolidated Group Inc said Tuesday its corporate parent, Mafco Holdings Inc, had proposed to buy all of the publicly-held shares of Mafco Consolidated for $38.50 cash each.
Mafco Holdings currently owns 85 percent of Mafco Consolidated.
Mafco Consolidated said it had asked a special committee of independing directors to consider the proposal in light of the overlapping equity ownership between the companies.

As part of the transaction with Mafco Holdings, Mafco Consolidated said it plans to sell to the public four million shares of Consolidated Cigar Holdings Inc, or about 13 percent of its 80 percent stake in Consolidated Cigar.
It will also offer $150 million of Mafco Consolidated notes, which will be exchangeable into shares of Consolidated Cigar held by Mafco.
The price tag of the Mafco buyout could change depending on Consolidated Cigar's stock price, which determines the amount of the gross proceeds of the stock and debt offerings.
The $38.50 a share price tag is based on Consolidated Cigar's closing NYSE share price yesterday of $24.50.
Mafco shares were halted earlier on the New York Stock Exchange, with the last trade at 26-3/4.

James Maher, president and chief executive of Mafco Consolidated, said in a statement, "The public market was not assigning adequate value to the stock of Mafco Consolidated Group. This transaction will provide the Mafco Consolidated public shareholders a substantial premium over the current market price, as well as simplify the holding company structure."
Mafco also owns about 36 percent of Power Control Technologies Inc on a fully diluted basis.
